item.title: Mendix Cloud Mendix Cloud Dedicated EU (Frankfurt) Sierra partial outage [resolved]
item.description:
Between 10:04 UTC and 20:00 UTC on August 21, applications in this dedicated cluster were unable to establish connections to other applications in the same dedicated cluster. Applications that depend on data provided by another application may have been unavailable to end users during this period.
The cause was identified in the platform network configuration and a fix has been applied. Connectivity between applications has been restored and confirmed. No action is required from customers, and it was not necessary to restart or redeploy applications. If you continue to experience any problems, please contact Mendix Support.

item.title: Mendix portal degraded performance [resolved]
item.description:
After implementing a fix and monitoring the results closely, we noticed the Mendix Portal functionality resumed back to normal. Therefore we will close the incident. As mentioned in one of our updates scheduled (planned) PostgreSQL 17 upgrade maintenances will be rescheduled.
If you continue to experience any problems, please contact Mendix Support.

item.title: App stability impacted after maintenance [resolved]
item.description: Maintenances have been cancelled due to platform instability. Any environment that experienced a cancelled maintenance can be operated normally. Some of the environments are experiencing high database load. This is due to failed optimization tasks during the maintenance. We are in the process of rescheduling them. Performance should return to normal after they have been executed.

item.title: Mendix Cloud: Application platform service degradation [resolved]
item.description:
This incident is now closed. The platform has remained stable with no new issues reported. All production and non-production environments are operating normally in the impacted regions.
Please reach out to Mendix Support in case you continue to experience any issues with your applications or environments.
Thank you for your patience throughout this incident.

item.title: Expired Certificate for *.mendix.com domain [resolved]
item.description: The expired wildcard TLS certificate for *.mendix.com has been replaced across all affected endpoints. We have verified that services have returned to normal operation across all Mendix Cloud regions. This incident is now resolved.

item.title: Issue with database provisioning on Mendix Cloud [resolved]
item.description:
Our cloud provider has restored capacity in the affected availability zone, and this incident is now resolved.
The issues with connecting to databases and deploying applications in the Mendix Cloud UK cluster have been cleared. Operations that were paused as a precaution, including first time deployments, downsizes, and database clears, can now be resumed safely.
If you continue to experience any problems, please contact Mendix Support.
We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience throughout the incident.
